Game Overview

Shadowbound Depths is a adventure title where descend into Shadowbound Depths, where every step counts in this turn-based dungeon crawler. Navigate randomly generated floors, engaging with fierce enemies and collecting potent gear. Survive in the dark, strategize every move, and descend deeper, testing your limits against ever-increasing dangers and the threat of the encroaching shadows.
